# AI use disclosure

This file records where and how AI tools were used, as required by AGENTS.md
section 11 (NASA Space Apps AI policy). It declares the tool used. It does not
attribute authorship or co-authorship: the repository owner is responsible for
the work and directs it.

Tool: Claude (Anthropic), used through Claude Code as a coding assistant.

## Code generated or modified with AI assistance

| Area | Files |
|---|---|
| Web viewer source | `web/src/**` |
| Data scripts | `web/scripts/extract-ctx-crop.mjs`, `web/scripts/inspect-geotiff.mjs`, `web/scripts/make-demo-fixture.mjs` |
| Tests | `web/tests/**` |
| Build and configuration | `web/package.json`, `web/tsconfig.json`, `web/vite.config.ts`, `web/index.html` |
| Documentation | `web/README.md`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, this file |

## Data generated with AI assistance

| Dataset | What it is |
|---|---|
| `web/public/replay/demo/*` | A simulated replay produced by `make-demo-fixture.mjs`: agent poses, routes, events, budgets, uncertainty (sigma) and a synthetic scarp added to the hidden evaluator reference. These are generated data, not observations, and are labelled simulated or fictitious in the manifest. |
| `web/scripts/data/ctx_crop.json` | A crop of NASA/USGS terrain data resampled by `extract-ctx-crop.mjs`. The heights are real data; only the resampling script was written with AI assistance. |

## Not generated by AI

- Terrain heights: Mars 2020 TRN CTX DTM mosaic, USGS Astrogeology / NASA.
- Astronaut 3D model: "Animated Astronaut Character in Space Suit Loop" by LasquetiSpice (CC BY 4.0). Only a material format conversion was applied with glTF Transform.
- Fonts: Rajdhani, Barlow Condensed, IBM Plex Mono (SIL OFL 1.1).
- Design references and the mission requirements come from the team's documents.

## Images, video and audio

No AI-generated images, video or audio are included. Screenshots of the viewer, if
published, show an interface that contains the AI-assisted code listed above and
simulated data; they must not be presented as NASA observations.

## Machine-readable metadata

- `web/package.json`: `aiDisclosure` field.
- `web/public/replay/demo/manifest.json`: `ai_disclosure` object.
